blocked.reason: Not on the bundled Wine 10 engine: the client's embedded Chromium window never paints there. It works on Highball's Wine 11 engine (CrossOver 26.3 base, build 15 or newer) with the cross-process browser fix (Wine bug 60263) and graphics mode DXMT: verified 2026-09-05 on an M1 Pro / macOS 26.6.2, the 'Log in to Ubisoft' window renders fully. Available once that engine is installable from Highball.

steps.name: DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN
steps.note: Connect's window is a Chromium browser whose GPU process draws into the main process's window. DXMT refuses such cross-process swapchains unless told the driver supports them; Highball's Wine 11 engine (build 15+) does.

steps.text: NSIS installer accepts /S for silent install. Disable the in-game overlay in Connect settings — it injects into games and breaks under Wine.

lastVerified.result: dxmt + DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 on the Wine 11 engine with the cross-process browser fix: 'Log in to Ubisoft' window renders fully and is interactive (not signed in; the account is the user's). Bundled Wine 10 engine: window still blank.

knownIssues.symptom: Launcher runs (tray icon, logs, game downloads via uplay links) but the window never paints. White under D3DMetal, DXMT and wined3d, black under DXVK.
knownIssues.cause: the 2025+ client's embedded Chromium UI fails GPU (ANGLE) init under this Wine build on every renderer, and its software fallback crashes under Wine on Apple Silicon. Verified 2026-08-25 across all four renderers, including with WINE_SIMULATE_WRITECOPY=1 (the CrossOver hack for this exact process, which stabilizes the browser processes but does not paint). Disabling DirectWrite for the client, which fixes Warframe's launcher, is not an option here: libcef.dll imports DWrite.dll as a hard dependency, so with dwrite disabled upc.exe fails to load at all (status c0000135, verified 2026-09-04 in a fresh bottle).
knownIssues.fix: none at the app level today. Works only in CrossOver 25.1+. Engine fix requested upstream at Sikarugir-App/Sikarugir#257; Highball will pick up a fixed engine as soon as one exists. Tracked in highball#15.
